SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.space_group
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
  UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')) IN ('L1_2', 'L12')
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
ORDER BY
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
)
AND LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.strukturbericht, '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', '')) = 'l12';

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE REPLACE(s.formula_type, '₃', '3') = 'A3B'
ORDER BY me.formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.lattice_a,
    s.lattice_b,
    s.lattice_c,
    s.space_group
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE regexp_replace(upper(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '') || ' ' || coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
  ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.prototype
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system ILIKE 'cubic'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.space_group,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
  s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
  OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
ORDER BY
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT me.*
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
  ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1;

SELECT DISTINCT me.entry_id, me.formula, me.reduced_formula
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 221;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.space_group,
  s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ti'
  AND upper(regexp_replace(translate(s.strukturbericht, '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^[:alnum:]]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT formula
FROM material_entry
WHERE number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY formula;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Pt'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula;

SELECT DISTINCT me.entry_id, me.formula, me.reduced_formula, me.chemical_system
FROM material_entry AS me
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
);

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.space_group
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ga'
  AND (
    upper(replace(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
    OR upper(replace(replace(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
  )
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM composition
WHERE site_label ILIKE 'A%'
ORDER BY element;

SELECT DISTINCT chemical_system
FROM material_entry
WHERE number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY chemical_system;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system ILIKE 'cubic'
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(s.space_group, fh.space_group) AS space_group
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'W'
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR fh.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY me.formula, me.entry_id;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
    fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
  FROM material_entry me
  JOIN composition c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND c.element = 'Ni'
  LEFT JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE (ps.is_stable IS TRUE OR fh.is_stable IS TRUE)
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht,
  energy_above_hull,
  formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM candidates
WHERE upper(
        regexp_replace(
          replace(concat_ws(' ', prototype, strukturbericht), '₂', '2'),
          '[^A-Za-z0-9]+',
          '',
          'g'
        )
      ) LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY formula;

WITH l12_negative AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.chemical_system AS element_combination,
        COALESCE(fh.reduced_formula, me.reduced_formula, fh.formula, me.formula) AS formula,
        fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
    FROM formation_enthalpy fh
    JOIN material_entry me
        ON me.entry_id = fh.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom < 0
      AND concat_ws(' ', fh.prototype, fh.strukturbericht, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht)
          ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%L1_2%', '%L12%', '%L1₂%', '%Cu3Au%'])
)
SELECT
    element_combination,
    COUNT(*) AS num_compounds,
    string_agg(
        formula || ' (' || formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom::text || ' eV/atom)',
        ', '
        ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
    ) AS compounds
FROM l12_negative
GROUP BY element_combination
ORDER BY element_combination;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
    COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1
  AND (
      COALESCE(fh.is_stable, ps.is_stable) = TRUE
      OR COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) = 0
  )
  AND (
      regexp_replace(
          lower(translate(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
          '[^a-z0-9]',
          '',
          'g'
      ) = 'l12'
      OR regexp_replace(
          lower(translate(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
          '[^a-z0-9]',
          '',
          'g'
      ) = 'l12'
  )
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula;

WITH composition_sums AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Ni' THEN atomic_fraction ELSE 0 END) AS ni_frac,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Al' THEN atomic_fraction ELSE 0 END) AS al_frac,
        COUNT(DISTINCT element) AS n_elements
    FROM composition
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
l12_structures AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM structure s
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
          OR UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%L12%'
      )
),
ni3al_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT me.entry_id
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN composition_sums cs ON cs.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(me.formula, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[[:space:]]', '', 'g') IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
       OR REGEXP_REPLACE(TRANSLATE(COALESCE(me.reduced_formula, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[[:space:]]', '', 'g') IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
       OR (
           cs.n_elements = 2
           AND ABS(cs.ni_frac - 0.75) < 0.01
           AND ABS(cs.al_frac - 0.25) < 0.01
       )
),
ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(ls.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM l12_structures ls
    JOIN ni3al_entries ne ON ne.entry_id = ls.entry_id
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    ls.prototype,
    ls.strukturbericht,
    ls.space_group_number,
    ls.crystal_system,
    ls.lattice_a,
    nr.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(ls.lattice_a - nr.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    100.0 * ABS(ls.lattice_a - nr.ni3al_lattice_a) / nr.ni3al_lattice_a AS percent_difference
FROM l12_structures ls
JOIN material_entry me ON me.entry_id = ls.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref nr
WHERE nr.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM ni3al_entries ne
      WHERE ne.entry_id = ls.entry_id
  )
ORDER BY lattice_a_difference ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  f.entry_id,
  f.formula,
  f.reduced_formula,
  f.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  f.energy_above_hull,
  COALESCE(f.prototype, s.prototype) AS prototype,
  COALESCE(f.strukturbericht, s.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht
FROM formation_enthalpy AS f
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = f.entry_id
WHERE f.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    COALESCE(f.strukturbericht, s.strukturbericht) IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR COALESCE(f.prototype, s.prototype) ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR COALESCE(f.prototype, s.prototype) ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR COALESCE(f.prototype, s.prototype) ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY f.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
  COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
  COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
  fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM material_entry me
JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
  (
    UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
  )
  AND COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) > 0
  AND COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) <= 0.1
ORDER BY energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom ASC;

WITH l12_compounds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        fh.entry_id,
        fh.formula,
        fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
    FROM formation_enthalpy fh
    LEFT JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
    WHERE fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND regexp_replace(
              translate(
                  upper(concat_ws(' ', fh.prototype, fh.strukturbericht, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht)),
                  '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉',
                  '0123456789'
              ),
              '[^A-Z0-9]',
              '',
              'g'
          ) LIKE '%L12%'
)
SELECT
    (floor(formation_energy_ev_per_atom / 0.1) * 0.1)::numeric(10,2) AS bin_lower_ev_per_atom,
    ((floor(formation_energy_ev_per_atom / 0.1) + 1) * 0.1)::numeric(10,2) AS bin_upper_ev_per_atom,
    COUNT(*) AS compound_count,
    MIN(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS min_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    MAX(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS max_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    AVG(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom
FROM l12_compounds
GROUP BY
    floor(formation_energy_ev_per_atom / 0.1)
ORDER BY
    bin_lower_ev_per_atom;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) AS is_stable
FROM material_entry me
JOIN composition c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND (
        COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) IN ('L1_2', 'L1₂', 'L12')
        OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) ILIKE '%L12%'
      )
ORDER BY
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) DESC NULLS LAST,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) ASC NULLS LAST;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.lattice_a
FROM structure s
JOIN material_entry me ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE s.lattice_a >= 3.5
  AND regexp_replace(
        translate(upper(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '') || ' ' || coalesce(s.prototype, '')),
                  '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
        '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
      ) LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a, me.formula;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
    s.space_group,
    s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND regexp_replace(
        translate(
            upper(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, s.prototype, fh.prototype, '')),
            '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉',
            '0123456789'
        ),
        '[^A-Z0-9]',
        '',
        'g'
      ) = 'L12'
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

WITH l12_entries AS (
  SELECT
    entry_id,
    MAX(prototype) AS prototype,
    MAX(strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht
  FROM (
    SELECT entry_id, prototype, strukturbericht FROM structure
    UNION ALL
    SELECT entry_id, prototype, strukturbericht FROM formation_enthalpy
  ) s
  WHERE upper(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
     OR upper(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
  GROUP BY entry_id
),
energies AS (
  SELECT entry_id, formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
  FROM phase_stability
  WHERE formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
  UNION ALL
  SELECT entry_id, formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
  FROM formation_enthalpy
  WHERE formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom <= -0.4
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (me.entry_id)
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  e.formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  l.prototype,
  l.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry me
JOIN l12_entries l ON l.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN energies e ON e.entry_id = me.entry_id
ORDER BY me.entry_id, e.formation_energy_ev_per_atom ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  fh.reduced_formula,
  fh.energy_above_hull,
  fh.prototype,
  fh.strukturbericht,
  fh.space_group
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE fh.energy_above_hull <= 0.01
  AND regexp_replace(
        translate(upper(concat_ws(' ', fh.prototype, fh.strukturbericht, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht)), '₂', '2'),
        '[^A-Z0-9]',
        '',
        'g'
      ) LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY fh.energy_above_hull ASC, me.formula;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    s.lattice_b,
    s.lattice_c,
    fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ti'
)
AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR fh.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
)
ORDER BY me.formula;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.lattice_a
FROM structure AS s
JOIN material_entry AS me
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system,
  COALESCE(s.prototype, fe.prototype) AS prototype,
  COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fe.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
  COALESCE(s.space_group, fe.space_group) AS space_group
FROM material_entry me
LEFT JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fe
  ON fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE me.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND (
    REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fe.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2') ILIKE 'L12'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fe.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fe.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fe.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY me.formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  lattice_a
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE is_stable = TRUE
  AND lattice_a < 3.6
  AND upper(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(strukturbericht, prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY lattice_a, formula;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy,
  COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull, pde.hull_distance) AS energy_above_hull,
  COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable, pde.is_on_hull) AS is_stable,
  ps.band_gap,
  pde.decomposition_products
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde
  ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM composition c
  WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    AND c.element = 'Nb'
)
AND (
  upper(replace(replace(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
  OR upper(replace(replace(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
)
ORDER BY energy_above_hull NULLS LAST, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Sc'
  AND (
    REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '_', '') = 'L12'
    OR REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '₂', '2'), '_', '') LIKE '%L12%'
  )
ORDER BY me.formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  energy_above_hull,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht,
  space_group
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE is_stable IS TRUE
  AND (
    replace(strukturbericht, '₂', '2') IN ('L1_2', 'L12')
    OR replace(prototype, '₂', '2') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR replace(prototype, '₂', '2') ILIKE '%L12%'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(s.space_group, fh.space_group) AS space_group
FROM material_entry AS me
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
  AND me.chemical_system NOT IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
ORDER BY me.chemical_system, me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT
  c.element AS a_site_element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM structure AS s
JOIN composition AS c
  ON c.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'A'
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC, c.element;

SELECT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  energy_above_hull,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht,
  space_group
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE
  upper(replace(replace(strukturbericht, '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
  OR upper(replace(replace(prototype, '₂', '2'), '_', '')) LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE s.lattice_a >= 4.0
  AND (
      regexp_replace(replace(lower(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
      OR regexp_replace(replace(lower(coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
  )
ORDER BY s.lattice_a, me.formula;

SELECT DISTINCT
  fe.entry_id,
  fe.formula,
  fe.reduced_formula,
  fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  fe.energy_above_hull,
  COALESCE(fe.prototype, s.prototype) AS prototype,
  COALESCE(fe.strukturbericht, s.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht
FROM formation_enthalpy fe
LEFT JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = fe.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM composition c
  WHERE c.entry_id = fe.entry_id
    AND c.element = 'Pd'
)
AND (
  fe.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  OR s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
  OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
)
ORDER BY fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;

WITH cu_l12 AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        MIN(COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull)) AS energy_above_hull,
        BOOL_OR(COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable, FALSE)) AS reported_stable,
        MAX(COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype)) AS prototype,
        MAX(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht)) AS strukturbericht
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN composition c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
       AND LOWER(c.element) = 'cu'
    LEFT JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        regexp_replace(translate(upper(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
        OR regexp_replace(translate(upper(COALESCE(fh.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
        OR regexp_replace(translate(upper(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
        OR regexp_replace(translate(upper(COALESCE(fh.prototype, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
    GROUP BY me.entry_id, me.formula, me.reduced_formula
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN reported_stable OR energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
        WHEN energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
        WHEN energy_above_hull IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
        ELSE 'unstable'
    END AS stability_class,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    energy_above_hull,
    reported_stable,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht
FROM cu_l12
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN reported_stable OR energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 1
        WHEN energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 2
        WHEN energy_above_hull IS NULL THEN 4
        ELSE 3
    END,
    energy_above_hull NULLS LAST,
    formula;

SELECT
  c.element AS b_site_element,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom
FROM composition c
JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'B'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE s.volume_per_atom <= 12
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR fh.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    COALESCE(s.space_group, fh.space_group) AS space_group
FROM material_entry AS me
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ir'
)
AND (
    UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '-', '_')) IN ('L1_2', 'L12')
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '-', '_')) IN ('L1_2', 'L12')
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR COALESCE(fh.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR COALESCE(fh.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
)
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT
  me.chemical_system,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS num_l12_binary_compounds,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT me.formula ORDER BY me.formula) AS formulas
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE me.number_of_elements = 2
  AND (
    REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
    OR REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
  )
GROUP BY me.chemical_system
ORDER BY me.chemical_system;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system,
  c_ni.atomic_fraction AS ni_atomic_fraction,
  COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
  COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
  COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
  COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) AS is_stable,
  fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  s.space_group_number,
  COALESCE(s.space_group, fh.space_group) AS space_group,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
  et.shear_modulus_vrh,
  et.youngs_modulus,
  tp.thermal_conductivity
FROM material_entry me
JOIN composition c_ni
  ON c_ni.entry_id = me.entry_id
 AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
LEFT JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
  ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN thermal_property tp
  ON tp.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
  me.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND c_ni.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
  AND (
    UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    OR COALESCE(s.formula_type, '') ILIKE 'A3B'
  )
  AND (
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) = TRUE
    OR COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) <= 0.05
  )
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) ASC NULLS LAST,
  c_ni.atomic_fraction DESC;

WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        COALESCE(
            fe.corrected_formation_enthalpy,
            fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
            ps.formation_energy_per_atom
        ) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
        COALESCE(fe.is_stable, ps.is_stable) AS is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fe
        ON fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR fe.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2%'
        OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
),
site_elements AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(site_label) IN ('A', 'A_SITE', 'A-SITE') THEN element END) AS a_site_element,
        MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(site_label) IN ('B', 'B_SITE', 'B-SITE') THEN element END) AS b_site_element
    FROM composition
    GROUP BY entry_id
)
SELECT
    se.a_site_element,
    se.b_site_element,
    COUNT(*) AS num_compounds,
    AVG(le.formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    MIN(le.formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS min_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    MAX(le.formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS max_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    STDDEV(le.formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS stddev_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE le.is_stable) AS num_stable_compounds,
    STRING_AGG(le.formula, ', ' ORDER BY le.formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS formulas
FROM l12_entries le
JOIN site_elements se
    ON se.entry_id = le.entry_id
WHERE
    se.a_site_element IS NOT NULL
    AND se.b_site_element IS NOT NULL
    AND le.formation_energy_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    se.a_site_element,
    se.b_site_element
ORDER BY
    avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom ASC;

WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a)) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE (
        me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
        OR me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    )
      AND (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    )
      AND COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
    r.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) - r.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    100.0 * ABS(COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_a_difference_percent,
    fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
    fh.energy_above_hull,
    fh.is_stable,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
WHERE (
    s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
)
  AND COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) IS NOT NULL
  AND fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom < 0
  AND ABS(COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a <= 0.02
  AND me.reduced_formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  AND me.formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
ORDER BY
    fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC,
    lattice_a_difference ASC;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
  (ps.is_stable = TRUE OR fh.is_stable = TRUE)
  AND (
    s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
  fe.entry_id,
  fe.formula,
  fe.reduced_formula,
  fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM formation_enthalpy fe
LEFT JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = fe.entry_id
WHERE fe.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = fe.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
  AND (
    LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(fe.prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) LIKE '%l12%'
    OR LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(fe.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) LIKE '%l12%'
    OR LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) LIKE '%l12%'
    OR LOWER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) LIKE '%l12%'
  )
ORDER BY fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;

SELECT
  c.element AS a_site_element,
  AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_constant,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.entry_id) AS compound_count
FROM structure s
JOIN composition c
  ON c.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'A'
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a_angstrom,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht
FROM material_entry me
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
    ON me.entry_id = fh.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure s
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) <= -0.3
  AND COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
  AND (
      COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE et.bulk_modulus_vrh >= 180
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC;

WITH ni3al_lattice AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition c_ni ON c_ni.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition c_al ON c_al.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE c_ni.element = 'Ni'
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'
      AND ABS(c_ni.atomic_fraction - 0.75) < 0.01
      AND ABS(c_al.atomic_fraction - 0.25) < 0.01
      AND me.number_of_elements = 2
      AND (
          s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      )
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    nl.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - nl.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) AS is_stable
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition c_co ON c_co.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_lattice nl
WHERE c_co.element = 'Co'
  AND c_co.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
  AND (
      s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND nl.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) ASC NULLS LAST,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - nl.ni3al_lattice_a) ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    c.element AS b_site_element,
    fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'B'
  AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
  AND (
      UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
      OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(fh.prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
  )
ORDER BY fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh AS shear_modulus_vrh_gpa
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fe
    ON fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    upper(regexp_replace(replace(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
    OR upper(regexp_replace(replace(COALESCE(fe.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12';

SELECT
  fe.entry_id,
  fe.formula,
  fe.reduced_formula,
  fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM formation_enthalpy AS fe
WHERE
  fe.is_stable IS TRUE
  AND fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    regexp_replace(lower(replace(coalesce(fe.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
    OR regexp_replace(lower(replace(coalesce(fe.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM structure AS s
      WHERE
        s.entry_id = fe.entry_id
        AND (
          regexp_replace(lower(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
          OR regexp_replace(lower(replace(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
        )
    )
  )
ORDER BY fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et
  ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM composition c
  WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    AND c.element = 'Ni'
)
AND (
  s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
  OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
)
AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom, et.bulk_modulus_vrh;

WITH stable_l12 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        fh.entry_id,
        fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
    FROM formation_enthalpy fh
    LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
    WHERE fh.is_stable IS TRUE
      AND (
          fh.strukturbericht = 'L1_2'
          OR s.strukturbericht = 'L1_2'
          OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      )
)
SELECT
    c.element AS a_site_element,
    AVG(sl.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom
FROM stable_l12 sl
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = sl.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'A'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.lattice_a,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
  et.shear_modulus_vrh,
  et.youngs_modulus,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
  (
    s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.45 AND 3.65
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_constant_a,
  fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  CORR(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a)) OVER () AS pearson_correlation
FROM material_entry me
JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2') IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
  )
ORDER BY lattice_constant_a;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN reduced_formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'TiCo3') OR formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'TiCo3') THEN 'Co3Ti'
      WHEN reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') THEN 'Ni3Al'
    END AS material,
    lattice_a,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY CASE
        WHEN reduced_formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'TiCo3') OR formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'TiCo3') THEN 'Co3Ti'
        WHEN reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') THEN 'Ni3Al'
      END
      ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM formation_enthalpy
  WHERE lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      reduced_formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'TiCo3', 'Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      OR formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'TiCo3', 'Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
    )
)
SELECT
  MAX(lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE material = 'Co3Ti' AND rn = 1) AS co3ti_lattice_a,
  MAX(lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE material = 'Ni3Al' AND rn = 1) AS ni3al_lattice_a,
  MAX(lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE material = 'Co3Ti' AND rn = 1)
    - MAX(lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE material = 'Ni3Al' AND rn = 1) AS lattice_a_difference,
  ABS(
    MAX(lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE material = 'Co3Ti' AND rn = 1)
      - MAX(lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE material = 'Ni3Al' AND rn = 1)
  ) AS absolute_lattice_a_difference
FROM ranked;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_stable) AS stable_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_stable) AS unstable_count
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fe.entry_id,
    fe.is_stable
  FROM formation_enthalpy fe
  JOIN composition c
    ON c.entry_id = fe.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = fe.entry_id
  WHERE c.element = 'Al'
    AND (
      fe.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    )
    AND fe.is_stable IS NOT NULL
) AS al_l12_compounds;

WITH l12_compounds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
        COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
        COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull, pde.hull_distance) AS energy_above_hull
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde
        ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.number_of_elements > 1
      AND (
          regexp_replace(
              upper(translate(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
              '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
          ) LIKE '%L12%'
          OR regexp_replace(
              upper(translate(COALESCE(fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
              '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
          ) LIKE '%L12%'
          OR regexp_replace(
              upper(translate(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
              '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
          ) LIKE '%L12%'
          OR regexp_replace(
              upper(translate(COALESCE(fh.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
              '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
          ) LIKE '%L12%'
      )
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    energy_above_hull
FROM l12_compounds
WHERE energy_above_hull > 0
ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC, entry_id;

SELECT
  c.element AS b_site_element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry me
JOIN composition c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'B'
  AND fh.is_stable IS TRUE
  AND (
    fh.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC, b_site_element;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  c.calculation_id,
  c.method,
  c.functional,
  cp.property_name,
  cp.tensor_component,
  cp.value,
  cp.unit
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property AS cp
  ON cp.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
WHERE
  (
    s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
  AND (
    c.method ILIKE '%DFT%'
    OR c.calculation_type ILIKE '%DFT%'
  )
ORDER BY
  me.formula,
  cp.property_name,
  cp.tensor_component;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM elastic_tensor et
JOIN calculation c
  ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
JOIN material_entry me
  ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE c.functional ILIKE 'PBE'
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂');

WITH l12_structures AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        s.lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.strukturbericht, '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      )
),
ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(ls.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM l12_structures ls
    JOIN composition c_ni ON c_ni.entry_id = ls.entry_id
    JOIN composition c_al ON c_al.entry_id = ls.entry_id
    JOIN material_entry me ON me.entry_id = ls.entry_id
    WHERE me.number_of_elements = 2
      AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'
      AND ABS(c_ni.atomic_fraction - 0.75) < 0.001
      AND ABS(c_al.atomic_fraction - 0.25) < 0.001
)
SELECT
    ls.entry_id,
    ls.formula,
    ls.reduced_formula,
    ls.lattice_a,
    nr.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(ls.lattice_a - nr.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_mismatch_angstrom,
    ABS(ls.lattice_a - nr.ni3al_lattice_a) / nr.ni3al_lattice_a * 100.0 AS lattice_mismatch_percent
FROM l12_structures ls
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref nr
WHERE nr.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lattice_mismatch_percent ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable AS phase_is_stable,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh,
    et.youngs_modulus,
    et.poisson_ratio,
    et.is_stable AS elastic_is_stable
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR fh.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  fe.reduced_formula,
  fe.prototype,
  fe.strukturbericht,
  fe.energy_above_hull,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fe
  ON fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE fe.is_stable = TRUE
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh >= 160
  AND (
    fe.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC;

WITH l12 AS (
  SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
    COALESCE(ps.formation_energy_per_atom, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
    COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(s.space_group, fh.space_group) AS space_group
  FROM material_entry me
  LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE
    (
      regexp_replace(upper(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, '') ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    )
    AND COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) IS NOT NULL
),
ni3al AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM l12
  WHERE reduced_formula IN ('AlNi3', 'Ni3Al') OR formula IN ('AlNi3', 'Ni3Al')
  ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  c.entry_id,
  c.formula,
  c.reduced_formula,
  c.prototype,
  c.strukturbericht,
  c.space_group,
  c.energy_above_hull,
  c.formation_energy_per_atom,
  c.lattice_a,
  ABS(c.energy_above_hull - n.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_diff_from_ni3al,
  ABS(c.lattice_a - n.lattice_a) AS lattice_a_diff_from_ni3al,
  ABS(c.lattice_a - n.lattice_a) / n.lattice_a AS lattice_a_relative_diff_from_ni3al,
  SQRT(
    POWER((c.energy_above_hull - n.energy_above_hull) / 0.05, 2) +
    POWER((c.lattice_a - n.lattice_a) / n.lattice_a, 2)
  ) AS similarity_score
FROM l12 c
CROSS JOIN ni3al n
WHERE c.entry_id <> n.entry_id
ORDER BY similarity_score ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    a.element AS a_site_element,
    b.element AS b_site_element,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS a
    ON a.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND a.site_label ~* '^A($|[_ -]?site$)'
JOIN composition AS b
    ON b.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND b.site_label ~* '^B($|[_ -]?site$)'
WHERE a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  );

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.prototype,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.volume_per_atom,
  CASE
    WHEN s.volume_per_atom IS NOT NULL AND s.volume_per_atom <> 0
      THEN 1.0 / s.volume_per_atom
    WHEN s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL AND s.lattice_b IS NOT NULL AND s.lattice_c IS NOT NULL
         AND s.lattice_a <> 0 AND s.lattice_b <> 0 AND s.lattice_c <> 0
      THEN 4.0 / (s.lattice_a * s.lattice_b * s.lattice_c)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS atoms_per_volume
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE
  UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '-', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
  OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '-', ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a;

SELECT DISTINCT
  fe.entry_id,
  fe.formula,
  fe.reduced_formula,
  fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  fe.energy_above_hull,
  COALESCE(fe.strukturbericht, s.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
  COALESCE(fe.prototype, s.prototype) AS prototype
FROM formation_enthalpy fe
LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = fe.entry_id
WHERE fe.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom <= -0.4
  AND (
    fe.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry AS me
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        ps.is_stable IS TRUE
        OR fh.is_stable IS TRUE
        OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.0
        OR fh.energy_above_hull <= 0.0
    )
    AND (
        s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L1₂', 'L12')
        OR fh.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L1₂', 'L12')
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1\_2%' ESCAPE '\'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1\_2%' ESCAPE '\'
        OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition AS c
        JOIN element AS e
            ON e.symbol = c.element
        WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
          AND (
              (LOWER(e.category) LIKE '%transition%' AND LOWER(e.category) LIKE '%metal%')
              OR e.block = 'd'
          )
    )
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula;

WITH l12_structures AS (
    SELECT
        s.entry_id,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.lattice_a AS precipitate_lattice_a
    FROM structure s
    WHERE
        s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1₂%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        )
),
majority_matrix_element AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.entry_id)
        c.entry_id,
        c.element AS matrix_element,
        c.atomic_fraction AS matrix_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition c
    ORDER BY c.entry_id, c.atomic_fraction DESC
),
matrix_lattice AS (
    SELECT
        p.element_symbol AS matrix_element,
        POWER(4.0 * p.volume_per_atom, 1.0 / 3.0) AS matrix_lattice_a
    FROM pure_element_reference p
    WHERE
        p.volume_per_atom IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            p.ground_state_spacegroup ILIKE '%Fm%'
            OR p.ground_state_spacegroup ILIKE '%225%'
            OR p.ground_state_spacegroup ILIKE '%fcc%'
        )
),
stability AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        COALESCE(MIN(ps.energy_above_hull), MIN(fh.energy_above_hull)) AS energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
        COALESCE(BOOL_OR(ps.is_stable), BOOL_OR(fh.is_stable)) AS is_stable,
        COALESCE(MIN(ps.formation_energy_per_atom), MIN(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom)) AS formation_energy_ev_atom
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    GROUP BY me.entry_id
),
elastic AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        AVG(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh,
        AVG(shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus_vrh,
        AVG(youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus,
        AVG(poisson_ratio) AS poisson_ratio,
        BOOL_OR(is_stable) AS elastic_is_stable
    FROM elastic_tensor
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        l12.prototype,
        l12.strukturbericht,
        l12.space_group_number,
        mme.matrix_element,
        mme.matrix_atomic_fraction,
        l12.precipitate_lattice_a,
        ml.matrix_lattice_a,
        100.0 * (l12.precipitate_lattice_a - ml.matrix_lattice_a) / ml.matrix_lattice_a AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
        st.energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
        st.is_stable,
        st.formation_energy_ev_atom,
        el.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        el.shear_modulus_vrh,
        el.youngs_modulus,
        el.poisson_ratio,
        el.elastic_is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN l12_structures l12 ON l12.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN majority_matrix_element mme ON mme.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN matrix_lattice ml ON ml.matrix_element = mme.matrix_element
    JOIN stability st ON st.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic el ON el.entry_id = me.entry_id
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    space_group_number,
    matrix_element,
    matrix_atomic_fraction,
    precipitate_lattice_a,
    matrix_lattice_a,
    lattice_mismatch_percent,
    energy_above_hull_ev_atom,
    is_stable,
    formation_energy_ev_atom,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    shear_modulus_vrh,
    youngs_modulus,
    poisson_ratio,
    elastic_is_stable
FROM candidates
WHERE
    COALESCE(is_stable, FALSE) = TRUE
    AND energy_above_hull_ev_atom <= 0.05
    AND ABS(lattice_mismatch_percent) <= 2.0
    AND COALESCE(elastic_is_stable, FALSE) = TRUE
    AND shear_modulus_vrh >= 50.0
    AND bulk_modulus_vrh >= 50.0
ORDER BY
    energy_above_hull_ev_atom ASC,
    ABS(lattice_mismatch_percent) ASC,
    shear_modulus_vrh DESC;

WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
        fh.energy_above_hull,
        fh.is_stable,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        et.shear_modulus_vrh,
        et.youngs_modulus,
        et.poisson_ratio
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        me.number_of_elements = 2
        AND (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
            OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
        )
        AND fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom < 0
        AND COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, 0) <= 0.05
        AND COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) BETWEEN 3.45 AND 3.85
        AND me.reduced_formula <> 'Ni3Al'
),
composition_check AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80 THEN c.element END) AS majority_element,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30 THEN c.element END) AS minority_element
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
    HAVING
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) = 2
        AND SUM(CASE WHEN c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
        AND SUM(CASE WHEN c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
)
SELECT
    l.entry_id,
    l.formula,
    l.reduced_formula,
    l.chemical_system,
    cc.majority_element,
    cc.minority_element,
    CASE
        WHEN cc.majority_element = 'Co' THEN 'Co-based gamma-prime candidate'
        ELSE 'Ni3Al replacement candidate'
    END AS candidate_type,
    l.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
    l.energy_above_hull,
    l.is_stable,
    l.lattice_a,
    l.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    l.shear_modulus_vrh,
    l.youngs_modulus,
    l.poisson_ratio,
    l.prototype,
    l.strukturbericht
FROM l12_candidates l
JOIN composition_check cc
    ON cc.entry_id = l.entry_id
WHERE
    l.youngs_modulus IS NULL
    OR l.youngs_modulus >= 100
ORDER BY
    l.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    l.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC,
    l.youngs_modulus DESC NULLS LAST,
    ABS(l.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC;

WITH ni_gamma AS (
    SELECT s.lattice_a AS a_ref
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.reduced_formula = 'Ni'
      AND s.space_group_number = 225
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - ng.a_ref) / ng.a_ref AS lattice_mismatch
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN ni_gamma ng ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE (
        mas.phase ILIKE '%γ''%'
        OR mas.phase ILIKE '%gamma prime%'
        OR mas.phase ILIKE '%gamma_prime%'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
      AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(energy_above_hull) OVER () = MIN(energy_above_hull) OVER () THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 - (
                (energy_above_hull - MIN(energy_above_hull) OVER ())
                / NULLIF(MAX(energy_above_hull) OVER () - MIN(energy_above_hull) OVER (), 0)
            )
        END AS stability_score,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(lattice_mismatch) OVER () = MIN(lattice_mismatch) OVER () THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 - (
                (lattice_mismatch - MIN(lattice_mismatch) OVER ())
                / NULLIF(MAX(lattice_mismatch) OVER () - MIN(lattice_mismatch) OVER (), 0)
            )
        END AS lattice_match_score,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER () = MIN(bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER () THEN 1.0
            ELSE (
                (bulk_modulus_vrh - MIN(bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER ())
                / NULLIF(MAX(bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER () - MIN(bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER (), 0)
            )
        END AS bulk_modulus_score
    FROM candidates
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY
            (
                0.40 * stability_score
              + 0.30 * lattice_match_score
              + 0.30 * bulk_modulus_score
            ) DESC
    ) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    space_group_number,
    lattice_a,
    lattice_mismatch,
    energy_above_hull,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    stability_score,
    lattice_match_score,
    bulk_modulus_score,
    (
        0.40 * stability_score
      + 0.30 * lattice_match_score
      + 0.30 * bulk_modulus_score
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM normalized
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC, energy_above_hull ASC, lattice_mismatch ASC;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh_gpa
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM phase_stability AS ps
      WHERE ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
        AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM formation_enthalpy AS fe
      WHERE fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
        AND fe.is_stable = TRUE
    )
  )
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM structure AS s
      WHERE s.entry_id = me.entry_id
        AND (
          UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
          OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
        )
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM formation_enthalpy AS fe
      WHERE fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
        AND (
          UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(fe.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
          OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(fe.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
        )
    )
  )
GROUP BY me.entry_id, me.formula, me.reduced_formula
ORDER BY bulk_modulus_vrh_gpa DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, s.prototype, fh.prototype) ~* 'L1[_ -]?2'
),
site_elements AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        string_agg(DISTINCT c.element, '/' ORDER BY c.element)
            FILTER (WHERE upper(c.site_label) = 'A') AS a_site_elements,
        string_agg(DISTINCT c.element, '/' ORDER BY c.element)
            FILTER (WHERE upper(c.site_label) = 'B') AS b_site_elements
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
stability AS (
    SELECT
        le.entry_id,
        le.formula,
        se.a_site_elements,
        se.b_site_elements,
        COALESCE(fh.is_stable, ps.is_stable) AS is_stable,
        COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
    FROM l12_entries le
    JOIN site_elements se
        ON se.entry_id = le.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = le.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = le.entry_id
    WHERE se.a_site_elements IS NOT NULL
      AND se.b_site_elements IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    a_site_elements,
    b_site_elements,
    COUNT(*) AS n_l12_compounds,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_stable) AS n_stable,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_stable)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        3
    ) AS stable_fraction,
    AVG(energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom) AS avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    MIN(energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom) AS min_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    AVG(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    STDDEV(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS stddev_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    (array_agg(DISTINCT formula ORDER BY formula))[1:10] AS example_formulas
FROM stability
GROUP BY
    a_site_elements,
    b_site_elements
ORDER BY
    stable_fraction DESC,
    avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST,
    n_l12_compounds DESC;

WITH prototype_l12 AS (
    SELECT prototype_id, prototype_name, strukturbericht
    FROM prototype_definition
    WHERE regexp_replace(replace(lower(concat_ws(' ', prototype_id, prototype_name, strukturbericht, formula_type, description)), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
       OR regexp_replace(replace(lower(concat_ws(' ', prototype_id, prototype_name, strukturbericht, formula_type, description)), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%cu3au%'
),
structure_summary AS (
    SELECT
        s.entry_id,
        AVG(s.lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL) AS lattice_a,
        BOOL_OR(
            regexp_replace(replace(lower(concat_ws(' ', s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, s.formula_type)), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
            OR regexp_replace(replace(lower(concat_ws(' ', s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, s.formula_type)), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%cu3au%'
            OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM prototype_l12 p
                WHERE lower(s.prototype) = lower(p.prototype_id)
                   OR lower(s.prototype) = lower(p.prototype_name)
                   OR lower(s.strukturbericht) = lower(p.strukturbericht)
            )
        ) AS is_l12
    FROM structure s
    GROUP BY s.entry_id
),
formation_summary AS (
    SELECT
        f.entry_id,
        AVG(f.lattice_a) FILTER (WHERE f.lattice_a IS NOT NULL) AS lattice_a,
        MIN(f.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
        BOOL_OR(f.is_stable) AS is_stable,
        BOOL_OR(
            regexp_replace(replace(lower(concat_ws(' ', f.prototype, f.strukturbericht)), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
            OR regexp_replace(replace(lower(concat_ws(' ', f.prototype, f.strukturbericht)), '₂', '2'), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%cu3au%'
            OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM prototype_l12 p
                WHERE lower(f.prototype) = lower(p.prototype_id)
                   OR lower(f.prototype) = lower(p.prototype_name)
                   OR lower(f.strukturbericht) = lower(p.strukturbericht)
            )
        ) AS is_l12
    FROM formation_enthalpy f
    GROUP BY f.entry_id
),
phase_summary AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        MIN(energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
        BOOL_OR(is_stable) AS is_stable
    FROM phase_stability
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
bulk_summary AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        MAX(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh
    FROM elastic_tensor
    WHERE bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
      AND bulk_modulus_vrh > 0
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
composition_summary AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT element) AS n_elements,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Ni' THEN atomic_fraction ELSE 0 END) AS ni_fraction,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Al' THEN atomic_fraction ELSE 0 END) AS al_fraction
    FROM composition
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
material_features AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        COALESCE(ss.lattice_a, fs.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
        bs.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        CASE
            WHEN ps.energy_above_hull IS NULL THEN fs.energy_above_hull
            WHEN fs.energy_above_hull IS NULL THEN ps.energy_above_hull
            ELSE LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, fs.energy_above_hull)
        END AS energy_above_hull,
        (
            COALESCE(ss.is_l12, FALSE)
            OR COALESCE(fs.is_l12, FALSE)
        ) AS is_l12,
        (
            COALESCE(ps.is_stable, FALSE)
            OR COALESCE(fs.is_stable, FALSE)
            OR COALESCE(
                CASE
                    WHEN ps.energy_above_hull IS NULL THEN fs.energy_above_hull
                    WHEN fs.energy_above_hull IS NULL THEN ps.energy_above_hull
                    ELSE LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, fs.energy_above_hull)
                END <= 1e-6,
                FALSE
            )
        ) AS is_stable,
        (
            (
                cs.n_elements = 2
                AND ABS(COALESCE(cs.ni_fraction, 0) - 0.75) <= 0.02
                AND ABS(COALESCE(cs.al_fraction, 0) - 0.25) <= 0.02
            )
            OR regexp_replace(lower(concat_ws(' ', me.formula, me.reduced_formula)), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%ni3al%'
            OR regexp_replace(lower(concat_ws(' ', me.formula, me.reduced_formula)), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%alni3%'
        ) AS is_ni3al
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN structure_summary ss ON me.entry_id = ss.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_summary fs ON me.entry_id = fs.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_summary ps ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN bulk_summary bs ON me.entry_id = bs.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN composition_summary cs ON me.entry_id = cs.entry_id
),
ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_features
    WHERE is_ni3al
      AND is_l12
      AND lattice_a IS NOT NULL
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        mf.*,
        r.ni3al_lattice_a,
        ABS(mf.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_mismatch_a,
        100.0 * ABS(mf.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / NULLIF(r.ni3al_lattice_a, 0) AS lattice_mismatch_percent
    FROM material_features mf
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
    WHERE mf.is_l12
      AND mf.is_stable
      AND NOT mf.is_ni3al
      AND mf.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND mf.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
      AND r.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
),
ranges AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS min_bulk,
        MAX(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS max_bulk,
        MIN(lattice_mismatch_percent) AS min_mismatch,
        MAX(lattice_mismatch_percent) AS max_mismatch
    FROM candidates
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        COALESCE((c.bulk_modulus_vrh - r.min_bulk) / NULLIF(r.max_bulk - r.min_bulk, 0), 1.0) AS bulk_score,
        COALESCE(1.0 - (c.lattice_mismatch_percent - r.min_mismatch) / NULLIF(r.max_mismatch - r.min_mismatch, 0), 1.0) AS lattice_score
    FROM candidates c
    CROSS JOIN ranges r
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        0.5 * bulk_score + 0.5 * lattice_score AS total_score
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_score DESC, bulk_modulus_vrh DESC, lattice_mismatch_percent ASC) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    lattice_a,
    ni3al_lattice_a,
    lattice_mismatch_percent,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    energy_above_hull,
    total_score
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank, entry_id;

WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.lattice_a AS precipitate_lattice_a,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        UPPER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
        OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%L12%'
        OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%L1₂%'
),
matrix_element AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.entry_id)
        c.entry_id,
        c.element AS matrix_element,
        c.atomic_fraction
    FROM composition c
    JOIN l12_candidates l ON l.entry_id = c.entry_id
    ORDER BY c.entry_id, c.atomic_fraction DESC
),
matrix_lattice AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (me.entry_id)
        me.entry_id,
        me.matrix_element,
        POWER(4.0 * per.volume_per_atom, 1.0 / 3.0) AS matrix_lattice_a
    FROM matrix_element me
    JOIN pure_element_reference per
        ON per.element_symbol = me.matrix_element
    WHERE per.volume_per_atom IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY me.entry_id, per.stability ASC NULLS LAST
),
candidate_properties AS (
    SELECT
        l.entry_id,
        l.formula,
        l.reduced_formula,
        l.chemical_system,
        l.prototype,
        l.strukturbericht,
        ml.matrix_element,
        l.precipitate_lattice_a,
        ml.matrix_lattice_a,
