        100.0 * ABS(l.precipitate_lattice_a - ml.matrix_lattice_a) / NULLIF(ml.matrix_lattice_a, 0) AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
        MAX(et.youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus,
        MAX(et.shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus_vrh,
        MIN(COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull)) AS energy_above_hull,
        MIN(COALESCE(ps.formation_energy_per_atom, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom)) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
        BOOL_OR(COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable, FALSE)) AS is_stable
    FROM l12_candidates l
    JOIN matrix_lattice ml ON ml.entry_id = l.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = l.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = l.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = l.entry_id
    WHERE l.precipitate_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        l.entry_id,
        l.formula,
        l.reduced_formula,
        l.chemical_system,
        l.prototype,
        l.strukturbericht,
        ml.matrix_element,
        l.precipitate_lattice_a,
        ml.matrix_lattice_a
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        cp.*,
        1.0 - (
            cp.lattice_mismatch_percent - MIN(cp.lattice_mismatch_percent) OVER ()
        ) / NULLIF(
            MAX(cp.lattice_mismatch_percent) OVER () - MIN(cp.lattice_mismatch_percent) OVER (),
            0
        ) AS mismatch_score,
        (
            cp.youngs_modulus - MIN(cp.youngs_modulus) OVER ()
        ) / NULLIF(
            MAX(cp.youngs_modulus) OVER () - MIN(cp.youngs_modulus) OVER (),
            0
        ) AS modulus_score,
        1.0 - (
            cp.energy_above_hull - MIN(cp.energy_above_hull) OVER ()
        ) / NULLIF(
            MAX(cp.energy_above_hull) OVER () - MIN(cp.energy_above_hull) OVER (),
            0
        ) AS stability_score
    FROM candidate_properties cp
    WHERE
        cp.lattice_mismatch_percent IS NOT NULL
        AND cp.youngs_modulus IS NOT NULL
        AND cp.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        0.35 * COALESCE(mismatch_score, 1.0)
        + 0.25 * COALESCE(modulus_score, 1.0)
        + 0.40 * COALESCE(stability_score, 1.0) AS precipitation_strengthening_score
    FROM normalized
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    matrix_element,
    precipitate_lattice_a,
    matrix_lattice_a,
    lattice_mismatch_percent,
    youngs_modulus,
    shear_modulus_vrh,
    energy_above_hull,
    formation_energy_per_atom,
    is_stable,
    precipitation_strengthening_score
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
    precipitation_strengthening_score DESC,
    lattice_mismatch_percent ASC,
    energy_above_hull ASC,
    youngs_modulus DESC
LIMIT 20;

WITH elastic_avg AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        AVG(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh,
        AVG(shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus_vrh,
        AVG(youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus,
        AVG(poisson_ratio) AS poisson_ratio
    FROM elastic_tensor
    WHERE is_stable IS TRUE OR is_stable IS NULL
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
l12_materials AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
        COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
        COALESCE(ps.formation_energy_per_atom, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
        COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) AS is_stable,
        ea.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        ea.shear_modulus_vrh,
        ea.youngs_modulus,
        ea.poisson_ratio
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_avg ea ON ea.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            UPPER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, '')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
            OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, '')) LIKE '%CU3AU%'
        )
),
ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM l12_materials lm
    WHERE
        lm.is_stable IS TRUE
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM composition c
            WHERE c.entry_id = lm.entry_id
              AND c.element = 'Ni'
              AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
        )
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM composition c
            WHERE c.entry_id = lm.entry_id
              AND c.element = 'Al'
              AND c.atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.20 AND 0.30
        )
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM composition c
            WHERE c.entry_id = lm.entry_id
              AND c.element NOT IN ('Ni', 'Al')
        )
    ORDER BY energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    lm.entry_id AS candidate_entry_id,
    lm.formula AS candidate_formula,
    lm.reduced_formula AS candidate_reduced_formula,
    lm.chemical_system AS candidate_chemical_system,
    lm.prototype,
    lm.strukturbericht,
    lm.formation_energy_ev_per_atom AS candidate_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    lm.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom AS candidate_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    lm.bulk_modulus_vrh AS candidate_bulk_modulus_gpa,
    lm.shear_modulus_vrh AS candidate_shear_modulus_gpa,
    lm.youngs_modulus AS candidate_youngs_modulus_gpa,
    lm.poisson_ratio AS candidate_poisson_ratio,
    n.entry_id AS ni3al_entry_id,
    n.formation_energy_ev_per_atom AS ni3al_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    n.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom AS ni3al_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    n.bulk_modulus_vrh AS ni3al_bulk_modulus_gpa,
    n.shear_modulus_vrh AS ni3al_shear_modulus_gpa,
    n.youngs_modulus AS ni3al_youngs_modulus_gpa,
    n.poisson_ratio AS ni3al_poisson_ratio,
    lm.formation_energy_ev_per_atom - n.formation_energy_ev_per_atom AS delta_formation_energy_vs_ni3al_ev_per_atom,
    lm.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom - n.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom AS delta_energy_above_hull_vs_ni3al_ev_per_atom,
    lm.bulk_modulus_vrh - n.bulk_modulus_vrh AS delta_bulk_modulus_vs_ni3al_gpa,
    lm.shear_modulus_vrh - n.shear_modulus_vrh AS delta_shear_modulus_vs_ni3al_gpa,
    lm.youngs_modulus - n.youngs_modulus AS delta_youngs_modulus_vs_ni3al_gpa
FROM l12_materials lm
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref n
WHERE
    lm.is_stable IS TRUE
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition c
        WHERE c.entry_id = lm.entry_id
          AND c.element = 'Co'
    )
ORDER BY
    lm.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST,
    lm.formation_energy_ev_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST;

WITH pure_refs AS (
  SELECT
    element_symbol,
    MIN(energy_per_atom) AS ref_energy_per_atom
  FROM pure_element_reference
  GROUP BY element_symbol
),
target AS (
  SELECT
    fe.entry_id,
    fe.formula,
    fe.reduced_formula,
    fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom + fe.weighted_ref_energy AS compound_energy_per_atom
  FROM formation_enthalpy fe
  WHERE fe.formula = 'Co3Ti'
     OR fe.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti'
)
SELECT
  t.entry_id,
  t.formula,
  t.compound_energy_per_atom
    - SUM(c.atomic_fraction * pr.ref_energy_per_atom) AS formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM target t
JOIN composition c
  ON c.entry_id = t.entry_id
JOIN pure_refs pr
  ON pr.element_symbol = c.element
GROUP BY
  t.entry_id,
  t.formula,
  t.compound_energy_per_atom;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) < 0 THEN 'negative formation energy'
    ELSE 'positive formation energy'
  END AS formation_energy_side,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) <= 0.05 THEN 'on/near hull'
    ELSE 'above hull'
  END AS hull_side,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) < 0
     AND COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) <= 0.05
      THEN 'Q1: stable promising candidate'
    WHEN COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) < 0
     AND COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) > 0.05
      THEN 'Q2: metastable candidate'
    WHEN COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) >= 0
     AND COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) <= 0.05
      THEN 'Q3: hull-near but endothermic'
    ELSE 'Q4: unstable candidate'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE (
    s.strukturbericht ~* 'L1[_ ]?2|L1₂'
    OR s.prototype ~* 'L1[_ ]?2|L1₂'
  )
  AND COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  stability_quadrant,
  energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
  formation_energy_ev_per_atom;

WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fh.entry_id
    FROM formation_enthalpy fh
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM (VALUES (fh.strukturbericht), (fh.prototype)) AS v(x)
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT regexp_replace(
                       upper(translate(coalesce(v.x, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
                       '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
                   ) AS norm
        ) n
        WHERE n.norm = 'L12'
           OR n.norm LIKE 'L12%'
           OR n.norm = 'CU3AU'
    )

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT s.entry_id
    FROM structure s
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM (VALUES (s.strukturbericht), (s.prototype)) AS v(x)
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT regexp_replace(
                       upper(translate(coalesce(v.x, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
                       '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
                   ) AS norm
        ) n
        WHERE n.norm = 'L12'
           OR n.norm LIKE 'L12%'
           OR n.norm = 'CU3AU'
    )
),
l12_structure AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.entry_id)
        s.entry_id,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system
    FROM structure s
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM (VALUES (s.strukturbericht), (s.prototype)) AS v(x)
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT regexp_replace(
                       upper(translate(coalesce(v.x, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
                       '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
                   ) AS norm
        ) n
        WHERE n.norm = 'L12'
           OR n.norm LIKE 'L12%'
           OR n.norm = 'CU3AU'
    )
    ORDER BY s.entry_id, CASE WHEN s.space_group_number = 221 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.structure_id
)
SELECT
    fh.entry_id,
    fh.formula,
    fh.reduced_formula,
    COALESCE(fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    -COALESCE(fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_depth_ev_per_atom,
    fh.energy_above_hull,
    fh.is_stable,
    COALESCE(fh.prototype, s.prototype) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(fh.strukturbericht, s.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system
FROM l12_entries le
JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = le.entry_id
LEFT JOIN l12_structure s ON s.entry_id = le.entry_id
WHERE COALESCE(fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) IS NOT NULL
  AND (fh.is_stable IS TRUE OR fh.energy_above_hull <= 0.05)
ORDER BY formation_energy_depth_ev_per_atom DESC, fh.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

WITH ni_ref AS (
  SELECT POWER(4.0 * volume_per_atom, 1.0 / 3.0) AS ni_fcc_lattice_a
  FROM pure_element_reference
  WHERE element_symbol = 'Ni'
  ORDER BY stability ASC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
),
l12_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
    fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) AS is_stable,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht
  FROM material_entry me
  JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) = TRUE
    AND COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) ILIKE 'L1_2'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) ILIKE 'L12'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype) ILIKE '%L12%'
    )
    AND me.chemical_system <> 'Al-Ni'
)
SELECT
  c.entry_id,
  c.formula,
  c.reduced_formula,
  c.chemical_system,
  c.prototype,
  c.strukturbericht,
  c.lattice_a AS candidate_lattice_a_angstrom,
  n.ni_fcc_lattice_a AS ni_fcc_lattice_a_angstrom,
  100.0 * (c.lattice_a - n.ni_fcc_lattice_a) / n.ni_fcc_lattice_a AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
  ABS(100.0 * (c.lattice_a - n.ni_fcc_lattice_a) / n.ni_fcc_lattice_a) AS abs_lattice_mismatch_percent,
  c.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  c.energy_above_hull
FROM l12_candidates c
CROSS JOIN ni_ref n
ORDER BY abs_lattice_mismatch_percent ASC, c.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  AND regexp_replace(
        translate(upper(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '') || ' ' || coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '₂', '2'),
        '[^A-Z0-9]',
        '',
        'g'
      ) LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a;

WITH l12_a_site AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        c.element AS a_site_element,
        e.period_number,
        CASE
            WHEN e.period_number = 4 THEN '3d transition metal on A site'
            WHEN e.period_number IN (5, 6) THEN '4d/5d transition metal on A site'
        END AS a_site_period_group,
        COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
        COALESCE(ps.formation_energy_per_atom, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
        COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) AS is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN composition c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN element e
        ON e.symbol = c.element
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        (
            UPPER(s.strukturbericht) IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
            OR UPPER(s.prototype) LIKE '%L12%'
            OR UPPER(s.prototype) LIKE '%L1_2%'
        )
        AND UPPER(c.site_label) = 'A'
        AND e.block = 'd'
        AND e.period_number IN (4, 5, 6)
)
SELECT
    a_site_period_group,
    COUNT(*) AS num_l12_compounds,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_stable) AS num_stable,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_stable)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        3
    ) AS stable_fraction,
    AVG(energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY energy_above_hull) AS median_energy_above_hull,
    AVG(formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY formation_energy_per_atom) AS median_formation_energy_per_atom
FROM l12_a_site
GROUP BY a_site_period_group
ORDER BY a_site_period_group;

WITH l12_materials AS (
  SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
    fh.energy_above_hull,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh
  FROM material_entry me
  JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
  JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE
    UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
),
ni3al_ref AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(l.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS ni3al_formation_enthalpy,
    MAX(l.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS ni3al_bulk_modulus
  FROM l12_materials l
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = l.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
      AND ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.75) < 0.01
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = l.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
      AND ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.25) < 0.01
  )
)
SELECT
  l.entry_id,
  l.formula,
  l.reduced_formula,
  l.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  l.energy_above_hull,
  l.bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM l12_materials l
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
WHERE l.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom < r.ni3al_formation_enthalpy
  AND l.bulk_modulus_vrh > r.ni3al_bulk_modulus
ORDER BY l.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC, l.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC;

SELECT
  fh.entry_id,
  fh.formula,
  fh.reduced_formula,
  COALESCE(fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  COALESCE(fh.strukturbericht, s.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
  COALESCE(fh.prototype, s.prototype) AS prototype
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
LEFT JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
WHERE fh.is_stable = TRUE
  AND COALESCE(fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) < -0.3
  AND (
    regexp_replace(
      translate(lower(COALESCE(fh.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
      '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g'
    ) = 'l12'
    OR regexp_replace(
      translate(lower(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
      '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g'
    ) = 'l12'
    OR regexp_replace(
      translate(lower(COALESCE(fh.prototype, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
      '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g'
    ) = 'l12'
    OR regexp_replace(
      translate(lower(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'),
      '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g'
    ) = 'l12'
  )
ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;

WITH l12_entry_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT entry_id
    FROM structure
    WHERE regexp_replace(upper(replace(replace(coalesce(strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '₁', '1')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
       OR regexp_replace(upper(replace(replace(coalesce(prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '₁', '1')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%L12%'

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT entry_id
    FROM formation_enthalpy
    WHERE regexp_replace(upper(replace(replace(coalesce(strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '₁', '1')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
       OR regexp_replace(upper(replace(replace(coalesce(prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '₁', '1')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%L12%'

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT s.entry_id
    FROM structure s
    JOIN prototype_definition pd
      ON s.prototype = pd.prototype_name
      OR s.strukturbericht = pd.strukturbericht
    WHERE regexp_replace(upper(replace(replace(coalesce(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '₁', '1')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
       OR regexp_replace(upper(replace(replace(coalesce(pd.prototype_name, ''), '₂', '2'), '₁', '1')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%L12%'
),
struct_lattice AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        avg(lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
        avg(lattice_b) AS lattice_b,
        avg(lattice_c) AS lattice_c
    FROM structure
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
form_lattice AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        avg(lattice_a) AS lattice_a
    FROM formation_enthalpy
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
lattice AS (
    SELECT
        l.entry_id,
        coalesce(sl.lattice_a, fl.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
        sl.lattice_b,
        sl.lattice_c
    FROM l12_entry_ids l
    LEFT JOIN struct_lattice sl ON l.entry_id = sl.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN form_lattice fl ON l.entry_id = fl.entry_id
),
stability_values AS (
    SELECT entry_id, energy_above_hull, is_stable
    FROM phase_stability
    UNION ALL
    SELECT entry_id, energy_above_hull, is_stable
    FROM formation_enthalpy
),
stability AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        min(energy_above_hull) FILTER (WHERE energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL) AS energy_above_hull,
        bool_or(is_stable) FILTER (WHERE is_stable IS NOT NULL) AS thermodynamically_stable
    FROM stability_values
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
elastic AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        avg(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh,
        avg(shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus_vrh,
        avg(youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus,
        bool_and(is_stable) FILTER (WHERE is_stable IS NOT NULL) AS elastically_stable
    FROM elastic_tensor
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
majority_element AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (entry_id)
        entry_id,
        element AS host_element,
        atomic_fraction AS host_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition
    ORDER BY entry_id, atomic_fraction DESC NULLS LAST, element
),
pure_ref AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (element_symbol)
        element_symbol,
        volume_per_atom
    FROM pure_element_reference
    WHERE volume_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND volume_per_atom > 0
    ORDER BY element_symbol, stability ASC NULLS LAST, energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
),
raw_base AS (
    SELECT
        l.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        maj.host_element,
        maj.host_atomic_fraction,
        st.energy_above_hull,
        st.thermodynamically_stable,
        lat.lattice_a,
        power(4.0 * pr.volume_per_atom, 1.0 / 3.0) AS reference_lattice_a,
        el.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        el.shear_modulus_vrh,
        el.youngs_modulus,
        el.elastically_stable,
        coalesce(
            el.youngs_modulus,
            9.0 * el.bulk_modulus_vrh * el.shear_modulus_vrh
                / nullif(3.0 * el.bulk_modulus_vrh + el.shear_modulus_vrh, 0.0),
            el.shear_modulus_vrh,
            el.bulk_modulus_vrh
        ) AS elastic_raw
    FROM l12_entry_ids l
    JOIN material_entry me ON l.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN stability st ON l.entry_id = st.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN lattice lat ON l.entry_id = lat.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic el ON l.entry_id = el.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN majority_element maj ON l.entry_id = maj.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN pure_ref pr ON maj.host_element = pr.element_symbol
),
raw_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        abs(lattice_a - reference_lattice_a) / nullif(reference_lattice_a, 0.0) AS lattice_mismatch
    FROM raw_base
),
ranges AS (
    SELECT
        min(elastic_raw) AS min_elastic_raw,
        max(elastic_raw) AS max_elastic_raw
    FROM raw_scores
    WHERE elastic_raw IS NOT NULL
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        r.*,
        CASE
            WHEN thermodynamically_stable IS TRUE THEN 1.0
            WHEN energy_above_hull IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN energy_above_hull <= 0 THEN 1.0
            ELSE exp(-energy_above_hull / 0.05)
        END AS stability_score,
        CASE
            WHEN lattice_mismatch IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE exp(-power(lattice_mismatch / 0.02, 2.0))
        END AS lattice_matching_score,
        CASE
            WHEN elastic_raw IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN elastically_stable IS FALSE THEN 0.0
            WHEN rg.max_elastic_raw = rg.min_elastic_raw THEN 1.0
            ELSE (elastic_raw - rg.min_elastic_raw) / nullif(rg.max_elastic_raw - rg.min_elastic_raw, 0.0)
        END AS elastic_score
    FROM raw_scores r
    CROSS JOIN ranges rg
),
final_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        stability_score * lattice_matching_score * elastic_score AS composite_score
    FROM scores
)
SELECT
    rank() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    host_element,
    energy_above_hull,
    lattice_a,
    reference_lattice_a,
    lattice_mismatch,
    elastic_raw AS elastic_modulus_score_basis,
    stability_score,
    lattice_matching_score,
    elastic_score,
    composite_score
FROM final_scores
ORDER BY composite_score DESC NULLS LAST, entry_id;

WITH stable_l12 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        fh.entry_id,
        fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
    FROM formation_enthalpy fh
    LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
    WHERE fh.is_stable IS TRUE
      AND fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          upper(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
          OR upper(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
          OR coalesce(fh.prototype, s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
          OR coalesce(fh.prototype, s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR coalesce(fh.prototype, s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      )
),
a_site AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        entry_id,
        element AS a_site_element
    FROM composition
    WHERE upper(site_label) = 'A'
       OR site_label ILIKE 'A-site'
       OR site_label ILIKE 'A site'
)
SELECT
    a.a_site_element,
    AVG(l.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
    COUNT(*) AS compound_count
FROM stable_l12 l
JOIN a_site a ON a.entry_id = l.entry_id
GROUP BY a.a_site_element
ORDER BY a.a_site_element;

SELECT
  fe.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  fe.reduced_formula,
  fe.prototype,
  fe.strukturbericht,
  fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  fe.energy_above_hull
FROM formation_enthalpy AS fe
JOIN material_entry AS me
  ON me.entry_id = fe.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = fe.entry_id
WHERE fe.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.entry_id = fe.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
  AND (
    fe.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  weighted_ref_energy,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE
  (
    strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR prototype LIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
  AND formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;
